title: Local and Neighboring Food Retail Supply and Population across Japan's Municipalities
abstract: arXiv:2611.02533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper examines the relationship between food retail supply and resident population across Japanese municipalities. I develop a partial-equilibrium framework in which local food retail improves consumption convenience and population density supports retail entry. The framework allows positive local feedback and distinguishes local retail from neighboring consumption opportunities. Using Japan's 2010, 2015, and 2020 Population Censuses and the 2012, 2016, and 2021 Economic Censuses, I estimate municipality fixed-effects specifications with spatially lagged explanatory variables. Local and neighboring food and beverage retail supply (FRS) are positively associated with resident population. The corresponding coefficients are 0.0893 and 0.1364, respectively, and remain positive when prefecture-by-wave fixed effects are introduced. translated_title: 日本各市町村的地方及周边食品零售供给与人口
translated_abstract: 本文考察了日本各市町村食品零售供给与居住人口之间的关系。我构建了一个局部均衡框架，其中本地食品零售改善消费便利性，而人口密度支持零售业进入。该框架允许正的本地反馈效应，并区分了本地零售与周边地区的消费机会。利用日本2010年、2015年和2020年人口普查以及2012年、2016年和2021年经济普查数据，我估计了包含空间滞后解释变量的市町村固定效应模型。结果显示，本地及周边食品饮料零售供给（FRS）均与居住人口呈正相关，相应系数分别为0.0893和0.1364，且在引入都道府县×调查波次固定效应后系数仍保持为正。基于同样本的比较表明，标准化的本地FRS关联性强于周边食品零售供给的关联性。
tldr: 本文构建了刻画本地食品零售与人口密度正反馈的局部均衡框架，并利用日本多期人口与经济普查数据发现，本地及周边食品零售供给均与市町村居住人口显著正相关（系数分别为0.0893和0.1364），且本地零售的关联性更强。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a partial-equilibrium framework capturing positive feedback between local food retail and population density, and using Japan's population and economic censuses finds that both local and neighboring food retail supply are positively associated with municipal resident population (coefficients of 0.0893 and 0.1364), with the standardized local association being stronger.
